entries.rationale: The package-root .env is writable configuration and may contain credentials; moving it changes installer and settings compatibility.
entries.migrationStrategy: Introduce an explicit config root, copy forward atomically, keep a read-only legacy fallback for one release, then remove package-root writes.

entries.rationale: The legacy memory tree defaults to the package root and contains session/shared state with its own layout and API semantics.
entries.migrationStrategy: Wire the existing MULTICC_MEMORY_ROOT override through createPaths, then perform a directory-level copy-forward with rollback metadata.

entries.rationale: The fallback gateway cwd can contain a live git workspace and native session context, so it is not a small state-file move.
entries.migrationStrategy: Create a gateway workspace port and relocate only after active-session detection plus worktree/CLI resume tests exist.

entries.rationale: Bridge cwd directories may be git repositories with resumable native agent state.
entries.migrationStrategy: Add a bridge-workspace port, detect active sessions, then copy or relocate one bridge at a time with rollback markers.

entries.rationale: Per-provider CODEX_HOME directories contain upstream CLI auth/config and must remain stable across process restarts.
entries.migrationStrategy: Version the materialized-home layout and add a per-provider copy-forward/rollback operation before changing its root.

entries.rationale: A private per-process CODEX_HOME overlay isolates the short-lived proxy capability from provider-shared configuration and is deleted when that child exits.
entries.migrationStrategy: Keep the root disposable, permission-restricted and capability-free in its pathname; prune abandoned overlays at startup without copying them forward.

entries.rationale: Logical-session history directories contain the canonical native rollout shared by Auto, managed, and Official physical routes across restarts; providerless routes synchronize only at idle route boundaries.
entries.migrationStrategy: Version the canonical layout; copy forward only a uniquely identified native rollout with durable atomic no-overwrite semantics, retain legacy sources for rollback, and fail closed on ambiguity.

entries.rationale: Per-session ZCode data roots contain private generated upstream credentials/config and isolate provider-backed sessions from ZCode's native Coding Plan state.
entries.migrationStrategy: Version the generated-home layout, preserve restrictive permissions, and add a per-session copy-forward/rollback operation before changing its root.

entries.rationale: Per-session KIMI_CODE_HOME roots isolate provider-bound Kimi Code sessions from the user's native ~/.kimi-code login and persist kimi-code's own session/config state across restarts.
entries.migrationStrategy: Version the generated-home layout, preserve restrictive permissions, and add a per-session copy-forward/rollback operation before changing its root.

entries.rationale: Installs without MULTICC_DATA_DIR still persist private CDP session cookies under the historical ~/.multicc root; configured installs are already isolated.
entries.migrationStrategy: Make MULTICC_DATA_DIR mandatory, copy qoder-cookies.json forward atomically with private permissions, retain a read-only legacy fallback for one migration window, then remove historical-root writes.

entries.rationale: The dsh adapter materializes a dedicated ~/.dsh/profiles/multicc profile (manifest, cordis patch, workspace yaml, version stamp, and a copy of vendor/dsh-runner under the profile's node_modules) so the multicc streaming runner rides over the user's own dsh install. dsh itself owns the rest of ~/.dsh (credentials, sessions, shared bundle tree).
entries.migrationStrategy: The profile is fully derived state: delete ~/.dsh/profiles/multicc and ensureDshProfile() rebuilds it on the next spawn. Only DSH_PROFILE_VERSION bumps rewrite it in place; never write outside this profile directory.

entries.rationale: Model weights are large shared assets selected by ASR_LOCAL_MODEL_DIR, not transactional MultiCC runtime state.
entries.migrationStrategy: Keep the explicit ASR_LOCAL_MODEL_DIR override; document backup/download behavior and never copy hundreds of MB during normal startup.

entries.rationale: The pinned private Node distribution and Qwen package are large replaceable third-party runtime assets, not transactional MultiCC state.
entries.migrationStrategy: Keep production assets below the dedicated voice runtime root, verify every downloaded artifact before activation, and reinstall from the pinned manifest instead of copying binaries when the layout changes.

entries.rationale: Resume cleanup edits Claude-owned JSONL transcripts and cannot be redirected to MultiCC's data root.
entries.migrationStrategy: Keep the adapter bounded to a supplied native-session location and add upstream-format characterization tests before changing behavior.

entries.rationale: Converted skills are intentionally installed into the user-owned .agents/.claude/.codex/.hermes skill stores.
entries.migrationStrategy: Continue treating provider skill roots as explicit external ports; cache-only state may move separately after installed-copy compatibility is tested.

entries.rationale: Recovery bundles and patches belong to the repository common dir so they remain available if a session worktree disappears.
entries.migrationStrategy: Retain repository-local ownership; add retention and explicit user cleanup without moving backups into process-global state.

entries.rationale: Uploads and git import bundles are bounded temporary files rather than restart-persistent runtime state.
entries.migrationStrategy: Keep OS-temp ownership, enforce private modes and lifecycle cleanup, and never treat these paths as durable API fields.

entries.rationale: New bundled copies receive MULTICC_ARTIFACTS_DIR, while older standalone copies may still fall back to the historical directory.
entries.migrationStrategy: Serve the legacy directory read-only during the compatibility window, refresh installed skills, then remove the writer fallback in a later major release.

entries.rationale: The server reads old artifacts so links created before migration do not break; cleanup never mutates this root.
entries.migrationStrategy: Remove the read fallback after the installed-skill compatibility window and documented expiry period.

entries.rationale: Explicit MULTICC_DATA_DIR instances are isolated, while installs without that setting retain the historical ~/.multicc/detached root so in-flight job evidence remains discoverable.
entries.migrationStrategy: Make the configured MultiCC data root mandatory, add a read-only fallback for historical jobs, and remove writes to the legacy root after the detached-job retention window.

entries.rationale: A package-local scheduled task file is read once and copied forward; all saves already use MULTICC_DATA_DIR.
entries.migrationStrategy: Remove the read fallback after one supported migration window; do not delete the legacy file automatically.

entries.rationale: The disposable Chrome profile and cookies are regenerable by re-login and already honor MULTICC_DATA_DIR when set.
entries.migrationStrategy: Resolve the browser-profile root through createPaths when the data root becomes mandatory; no copy-forward of profiles or cookies is needed.

entries.rationale: Official-account OAuth credentials (Codex mini-homes, Claude PKCE token files) are multicc-owned login state that must survive restarts and stay isolated from the CLIs' global logins.
entries.migrationStrategy: Move the root behind a createPaths port and copy the whole account tree forward atomically (credentials are single-writer, so a directory-level move with a rollback marker suffices).
